info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Banking Facilities Site Operations Status-v5-spec
info.description: The Banking Facilities Site Operations Status API provides real-time status updates of various banking facilities and their operational capabilities. This API enables users to access crucial information about site operations, facilitating better decision-making and enhanced service delivery. Typical consumers include banking administrators and operations managers who require insights into facility performance. By integrating this API, organizations can improve operational transparency and responsiveness to consumers' needs.

get.summary: Retrieve the status of site operations.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to request the current operational status of facilities. It provides important insights into the functioning of site activities, helping stakeholders to make informed decisions.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of site operations. Ensure you provide all necessary parameters to get an accurate status.

200.description: Request completed successfully, indicating the current status of site operations.
